motivation.zh: 给 FR-7022 建立两条可独立推进的充分归约，保留原题、阈值与常数。
motivation.en: Provide two sufficient routes to FR-7022 while preserving its frozen range and constants.

tasks.statement: ∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 8000000000 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840 * Real.log (n:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 把 BMOR 定理 1.1 的小模数 ψ 估计形式化
plain_statement.en: Formalize the small-modulus ψ bound of BMOR Theorem 1.1

brief.zh: 从定理 1.1 的式 (1.9)–(1.11) 取 q=3…105 的范围。保留 x≥8×10⁹ 和 1/840，核对端点包含在求和内。权威核验需要 Lean 证明及所用数值证书。
brief.en: Specialize (1.9)–(1.11) to 3 ≤ q ≤ 105. Retain the threshold and constant, reconcile the inclusive sum, and provide checked proofs for the analytic and numerical inputs.

tasks.statement: ∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), (if k.Prime then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0)) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/200

plain_statement.zh: 只计素数，给等差数列的误差留出 n/200
plain_statement.en: Bound the prime-only progression error by n/200

brief.zh: 对素数有 Λ(p)=log p。BMOR 定理 1.2 控制 q≥3；q=2 用模 4 的两个奇剩余类，q=1 再加素数 2。保留阈值 10¹⁶。
brief.en: Use Λ(p)=log p and Theorem 1.2 for q ≥ 3. For q=2 combine both odd classes modulo four. For q=1 also include the prime two. Keep the explicit threshold.

tasks.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 10^16 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (if k.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/200

plain_statement.zh: 给所有高次素数幂一个显式的 n/200 总预算
plain_statement.en: Give all higher prime powers a global n/200 budget

brief.zh: 对 pᵏ≤n、k≥2，用已有底数上界 √n 和指数上界 log₂ n。于是总权重至多 √n·log₂(n)·log n；验证它从 10¹⁶ 起小于 n/200。可独立于等差数列完成。
brief.en: Use the base and exponent cutoffs for pᵏ ≤ n with k ≥ 2. Bound the total by √n log₂(n) log n and check the ratio from 10¹⁶ onward. No progression estimates are required.

tasks.statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 8000000000 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840 * Real.log (n:ℝ))) → (∀ q n : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → 1 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => ¬ Nat.Coprime k q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) ≤ (q.primeFactors.card:ℝ)*Real.log n) → (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/100)

plain_statement.zh: 由 BMOR 的 ψ 界恢复 FR-7022 的全部模数
plain_statement.en: Recover the full FR-7022 modulus range from BMOR ψ

brief.zh: 模 4 的奇类补足 q=2；再用 FR-7023 控制偶数权重补足 q=1。其余模数直接换算误差。
brief.en: Add the two odd classes modulo four for q=2, then use FR-7023 on the even contribution for q=1. The other moduli use the explicit error directly.

tasks.statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), (if k.Prime then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0)) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/200) → (∀ n : ℕ, 10^16 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (if k.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/200) → (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/100)

plain_statement.zh: 合并素数与高次幂的两个半预算，推出 FR-7022
plain_statement.en: Combine the prime and higher-power budgets for FR-7022

brief.zh: 一个剩余类内的非素数权重非负且至多为全局总量。把两个 n/200 相加，得到原声明要求的 n/100。
brief.en: The nonprime weight in each class is nonnegative and bounded by the global sum. Adding the two n/200 budgets gives the original n/100.

explanation.zh: 模 4 的奇类补足 q=2；再用 FR-7023 控制偶数权重补足 q=1。其余模数直接换算误差。
explanation.en: Add the two odd classes modulo four for q=2, then use FR-7023 on the even contribution for q=1. The other moduli use the explicit error directly.

explanation.zh: 一个剩余类内的非素数权重非负且至多为全局总量。把两个 n/200 相加，得到原声明要求的 n/100。
explanation.en: The nonprime weight in each class is nonnegative and bounded by the global sum. Adding the two n/200 budgets gives the original n/100.

route_note.zh: FR-7022 可按 BMOR 的 ψ 界推进，也可独立控制素数误差和高次素数幂。两条路线保留同一个百分比阈值。
route_note.en: For FR-7022, formalize the BMOR ψ estimate or separately bound primes and higher powers. Both routes preserve the one-percent target.
